candidate.summary: While walking through the forest, the Tin Woodman recounts how the Wicked Witch of the East repeatedly sabotaged his attempts to marry a beautiful Munchkin girl, causing him to replace his body with tin and ultimately lose his heart. He explains that rust immobilized him until Dorothy and the Scarecrow helped him, and that he now seeks Oz's help to obtain a new heart and marry the Munchkin maiden.
